node_definition.done_when: Per §8 of the plan: _run_reserved_probe raises with the tail of the child's stream as well as its exit status; the claude account read in reckon/_backends.py calls https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20 header and parses top-level five_hour and seven_day, utilization as a percentage converted to the fraction the document carries, resets_at as an ISO string, still refusing an answer carrying neither window; the publish gate in reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py treats an account whose every window is unknown as due for a probe under the existing recent guard. Tests with recorded answers and no network request cover every case the section lists (model_not_found reason surfaced; 62.0 and 74.0 parsed to 0.62 and 0.74; no-window answer refused; all-unknown account probed outside the guard and not inside it). One live request in the foreground confirms the new read against the real endpoint, its answer logged with the token redacted, and the manifest records the published document's claude windows reading observed after one timer pass. The backends.claude.model configuration in ~/.config/reckon/flight.yaml is operator configuration and must not be changed. Every test file importing the changed modules, rebuilt from the head tree, adds no failure against a base arm, both arms from git checkouts under the run's own scratch directory with RECKON_SESSION_HOST_SETTLE, RECKON_FOLLOWER_OWNER, RECKON_FOLLOWER_IMAGE_COMMIT and RECKON_FOLLOWER_SOURCE_ROOT unset, run in place on the fleet node with pytest -n 8; any id failing in one arm only is run five times alone in each arm. Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT=. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the changed files, judged against the base blobs.
